name: recode runs of ones in the multiplier as one subtract and one add
mechanism: scan adjacent pairs of multiplier bits; a run of ones contributes a subtraction of the multiplicand at its start and an addition at its end instead of one addition per bit, and the same rule handles negative two's-complement multipliers without a sign case

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Booth's multiplication algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Elementary and special functions: a multiplication algorithm that multiplies two signed binary numbers in two's complement notation

fails_when: alternating bit patterns are the worst case (no runs)
